caption: The drawing depicts a detailed, three-dimensional architectural capital in a corner perspective, rendered primarily in beige, brown, and muted red tones. The capital features a rectangular abacus with swirling and concentric circular patterns along its surface and borders. Below the abacus, two vertical, rectangular brackets or supports are attached, each decorated with stylized floral rosettes on the front faces and curved, leaf-like or feather-like motifs running vertically. Both the horizontal and vertical surfaces display continuing geometric and organic decorative patterns in similar colors, with the overall composition concentrated in the top left quadrant of the image, against a plain, off-white background. The artist’s signature, "H. L. Blakeney," appears in small red text at the lower right of the drawn object.
title: Bracket, for Wall (Ecclesiastical)
